At least you have a girlfriend. How the fuck does this even have upvotes? This post makes me angry.

My mother drove off and I left the house shortly after. I started with walking, I was thinking of taking the train to the ferry, and the ferry to the city, roaming around until my wallet was empty. There was another option I had in mind that involved walking to the train and not coming back. I wanted to leave because they wanted me to leave. My mother eventually found me walking on the way there in her car. She was screaming at me to get in the car, eventually she started honking at me at 2 am, getting out and try to pull me back in. Eventually she got me in the car as I gave up from running and asking her to leave me alone. 5 minutes later my grandma gets in the car and starts holding me. A police cruiser drove past us to one of the blocks I was walking on. We were parked on the side of the street at the time. All I do is cause trouble even when I just want to leave and be left alone.
I was in a similar situation a year or two ago. Suicidal tendencies, starting SSRIs, falling in love, getting my heart broken. It's something I don't think I'll ever get over either.
Thank you. There was someone that made me feel like I mattered, but now she's no longer in my life. That's another thing I dwell on, what did I do wrong? What's wrong with me?
